semantics.summary: Student started with a codebase containing fundamental compilation errors affecting all 29 tests. Made minimal progress, with only testHeight() passing by the end of the episode. Attempted initial fixes but struggled with basic syntax and structural issues.

Major breakthrough in implementing core BST functionality. Fixed compilation errors and implemented the BinaryNode inner class, constructor, and insert() method with helper recursion. Unlocked basic_insert and tree_properties categories with 4 new tests passing. However, introduced a critical null-pointer dereference bug in insertHelper that caused instability.

Extended functionality across multiple categories through trial-and-error debugging. Implemented contains() method, toArrayList(), and toString() conversion methods. Fixed the insertHelper null-check bug and added comparison operators for tree traversal. Unlocked search_contains and conversion categories. Progress was uneven with multiple regressions and recoveries, but net gain of 7 tests passing by episode end.

Focused on implementing deletion and iterator functionality. Implemented remove() method with recursive helper and successor-finding logic, unlocking the deletion category. Added modCount field and iterator infrastructure for concurrent modification tracking. Achieved 5 new tests passing including testPreOrderIterator, but introduced ConcurrentModificationException and StackOverflowError in other tests. Ended with 21/24 tests passing (87.5%).

Final debugging push to stabilize the codebase. Fixed ConcurrentModificationException and StackOverflowError from previous episode, allowing testIterator to pass and completing the iterators category. However, fixes broke exception handling for null elements in testInsertExceptions and testRemoveIllegalArgumentException. Also introduced a logic error in testEfficiency (missing element 20). Ended at 21/24 tests passing with 3 remaining failures.
